title: Belgian Fries
description: A traditional Belgium dish made with potato, sea salt. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Wash and prepare the listed produce; dice or chop evenly for a consistent texture.
Fry thick-cut potato batons first at 140–150°C until softened but pale. Drain and cool completely before the second fry.
Cool the prepared ingredients promptly, then refrigerate for about 15 minutes until properly chilled.
Fry the cooled potatoes again at 180–190°C until deeply golden and crisp; drain immediately.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
